provider_receipt.summary: Review found unsupported completion and named defects: (1) src/lib.rs:56-89 MemoryStore::store only serializes a MemoryRecord and discards it, so scan_vault provides no durable Mnemosyne persistence despite the stated integration; annunimas-mnemosyne is never used. (2) src/lib.rs:13-25 accepts an obsolete frontmatter shape that conflicts with docs/human-knowledge-ingestion-contract.md:71-93: required authority, privacy, provenance, review, supersession, and contract fields are absent, while contract confidence values low/medium/high cannot deserialize into u8. (3) src/lib.rs:184-192 resolves slash-containing and absolute wikilinks without constraining the result to the vault root, allowing existence probing outside the private vault via traversal or absolute paths. (4) src/lib.rs:110-114 silently drops WalkDir traversal errors, permitting incomplete scans to report success. (5) Durable dependency evidence establishes only successful close receipts and a clean-tree check; it supplies no functional or security verification supporting the implementation. Declared checks were not rerun, and no files were modified.
